verdicts.decision_note: The client accepts CMYK calibration for the selected fabric and supplier and identifies the fabric and Pantone-reference inputs governing production color preparation.
The client confirms the visual-approximation and Pantone-refinement workflow and agrees to obtain the supplier ICC profile for production-file color calibration.
The client unambiguously accepts documenting exact CMYK values and nearest Pantone equivalents for every production color.
Target-specific first implementation claim: the freelancer reports delivering a Technical Sheet with final CMYK and Pantone references corresponding to the revised shades.
